summary.text: Brad Paquette is a Republican state representative from Michigan House District 37 who has held a seat in the Michigan House since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an educator from Niles.

paragraphs.text: Brad Paquette lives in Niles, Michigan, and earned a B.A. in political science from Northern Michigan University in 2009 and an M.A. in teaching from Andrews University in 2012.
His career experience includes working as an educator with Niles New Tech Entrepreneurial Academy, and he has served on the City of Niles Planning Commission.
Paquette's tenure in the Michigan House began in 2019, and he has represented District 37 since January 1, 2023.

He was majority vice chair of the Education Committee in the 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions, advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026, and in 2025-2026 sits on the Education and House Oversight committees.
